data_objects.name: automobile_records
data_objects.meaning: Automobile records containing fuel economy, engine configuration and output, vehicle weight, acceleration, model year, and origin coding.

variables.name: mpg
variables.meaning: Vehicle fuel economy expressed as miles traveled per gallon.

variables.name: displacement
variables.meaning: Engine displacement measure; its volume unit is not stated.

variables.name: horsepower
variables.meaning: Engine power rating expressed in horsepower.

variables.name: weight
variables.meaning: Vehicle weight measure; its mass unit is not stated.

variables.name: acceleration
variables.meaning: Vehicle acceleration measure; its definition and time unit are not stated.

variables.name: origin
variables.meaning: Numeric categorical code for vehicle origin; the codebook is not supplied.

structure.description: Each row represents one automobile record described by performance, engine, mass, model-year, and origin fields.

uncertainties: Units for displacement, weight, and acceleration are not stated, and the origin codebook is absent.
No vehicle identifier or make/model field is provided.
annotation_notes: Semantics are limited to the column labels and numeric values visible in train.csv.
